intro: Lesson 24: Uthman and the copies of the mushaf. To understand how Uthman (رَضِيَ اللّٰهُ عَنْهُ) united the Muslims on one written copy of the Qur'an and sent copies to the cities

passage.title: al-Hijr 15:9
paras: Indeed, it is We who sent down the Reminder, and indeed, We will be its guardian.

questions.q: Explain why Uthman had copies of the mushaf made.
questions.a: People in new lands differed in recitation, so he united them on one agreed written text.
questions.model: Point: to unite the Muslims. Evidence: Hudhayfah warned Uthman about arguments over recitation (Bukhari). Explain: one agreed copy in every city stopped the disagreement.

questions.q: Make a flow chart on the pupil PDF: from the Prophet ﷺ to Abu Bakr's collection to Uthman's copies to the mushaf in your home. Add one sentence for each step.
questions.a: Revealed and memorised; collected in Abu Bakr's time; copied and sent by Uthman; the same text today
questions.model: Teacher writes step 1: 'The Qur'an was revealed to the Prophet ﷺ and memorised by the companions.'

questions.q: who kept Abu Bakr's pages safe?
questions.a: Hafsah, the Prophet's ﷺ wife and Umar's daughter

questions.q: why does 15:9 give Muslims confidence in the Qur'an?
questions.a: Allah Himself promised to guard it
A written copy of the Qur'an
options: A written copy of the Qur'an

questions.q: Back to our ponder: how is the Qur'an the same everywhere?
questions.a: Allah protects it; Uthman's copies from one agreed text
